chain_words.nuance: far better than others, impressive and memorable

explanation: All five words describe a positive quality, from merely acceptable up to something that clearly stands out above the rest.

usage_notes.difference: 'Good' is a neutral, general positive word; 'great' is stronger and often expresses enthusiasm. Portuguese speakers may translate both as 'bom', so they may use 'good' where 'great' sounds more natural in an advertisement.
